title: a path: selector with a relative path is rejected before any Orca call: a relative path cannot be compared
source: intended: TS-ODDITIES L4 (owner decision, defect N-22): the folder Orca reports is checked on every launch
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES L4, owner decision, defect N-22). A path-naming selector must be absolute, because its path is compared with the real paths of the worktrees. A relative one exits 2 before any Orca call and writes nothing. The TS binary forwards it and launches (exit 0).

stderr.equals: JITSO REJECTED: --worktree path:rel/x must name an absolute path
